inherits: reports/sk_v5_wave_a_root_adjudication_protocol.json — all Wave-A checks remain in force.

root_verification: confirm each candidate is decidable by a metadata/key-only diagnostic before any fit
reject any candidate needing an input unavailable at D-1 14:00
classify each feature as re-encoding the existing 820-name representation versus adding new information
require same-issuance/same-run legality proof for every neighbour, lag, rolling or gradient construction
check every decision-focused claim against the exact 4/3/0 band reward rather than a generic step loss
reject any rung that is the closed post-processing axis in new wording
verify repository existence, licence file and last-release metadata by direct HTTP
verify that ablation evidence actually isolates the named component
mark INELIGIBLE any pipeline depending on data outside the BARAM boundary
independently re-run the five gates: pre-2026-07-05 release, commercial licence, D-1 14:00 archival availability, anonymous retrieval, deployment symmetry
require bucket listing, index file, Last-Modified or official schedule evidence, never a search snippet
an empty ELIGIBLE set is an acceptable accepted verdict

cross_lane_rules: A candidate proposed by two lanes is deduplicated to one hypothesis with the union of its scope gaps.
Any candidate matching a closed axis is rejected unless it carries a new direct source mechanism or a new local deficit; the specific novelty must be named.
No lane may consume a comparison index, promote a candidate, or grant execution authority.
Every surviving candidate must map to at least one FD deficit and to one stage in S5..S8.
Ranking across lanes uses the DS@v5 acquisition order: confirmation obligation, causal leverage on the frozen deficits, information per cost, diversity, age; ties are logged.
execution_boundary: Wave-B research produces hypotheses only. Their execution requires IP@v3 approval and the WP12 foundation diagnostics first.
